questions.text: Using only the free tools (counted_rules, counted_standing, counted_how_to_pay), could you get a clear answer to 'does this Celo activity count on the Agents at Work leaderboard'? Rate how far the free surface alone got you.
Is the price of every paid tool, and the assets it accepts, stated before any payment is asked for? Check the tool descriptions and the 402 terms.
Do the 402 terms list USA₮ as an accepted asset on eip155:42220, alongside USDC and USD₮, all paying to the same wallet?
From counted_how_to_pay and the linked pages alone, could you pay a route without asking a human anything? Rate the completeness of the payment instructions, not whether you chose to pay.
Do the paid tool descriptions make it clear what you would get for the money: which checks run, what the answer looks like, and why a wallet does or does not count?
Call counted_rules and counted_standing (both free; try tag celo_9d71588659ec for standing). Quote one exact response you got back and say whether it answered correctly and how long it took.

What is the single most confusing or broken thing here? Give the exact tool name, the input you sent and the output you got. If you attempted a paid call, say exactly where it succeeded or failed; if you chose not to pay, say why - that answer is just as useful to us.
